title: Regulatory Affairs Manager/Senior Manager – CMC & Regulatory Change Management - FSP
description:
**Work Schedule**


Standard (Mon\-Fri)**Environmental Conditions**


Office**Job Description**


Join our global Regulatory Affairs team in a client\-dedicated role supporting commercial medicinal products used in clinical trials, including comparator and auxiliary medicinal products.


This highly client\-facing position combines **EU/EEA regulatory assessment, CMC and labelling expertise, regulatory change control, Summary of Changes preparation, regulatory intelligence and cross\-functional coordination**.


Strong CMC expertise is essential; however, the primary focus is broader than CMC authoring. The role will assess proposed changes, determine regulatory impact, coordinate implementation activities and support the development of effective processes and ways of working.

**What You’ll Do**
------------------

* Perform **EU/EEA regulatory assessments of changes**, applying applicable legislation, EU Clinical Trials Regulation requirements and regulatory guidance.
* Assess the impact of CMC, manufacturing, supply and labelling changes on clinical trial documentation and determine appropriate regulatory actions, including substantiality assessments where applicable.
* Prepare and maintain **Summary of Changes (SoC)** documentation.
* Manage:
	+ **Product\-specific changes** impacting sIMPDs, SmPCs and clinical labels.
	+ **Non\-product\-specific changes** impacting manufacturing/release site lists, manufacturing licences and GMP certificates.
* Review and compare revised SmPCs, clinical labels, manufacturing licences, GMP certificates and related documents to identify and assess relevant changes.
* Provide CMC regulatory expertise and support targeted authoring, updating or expert review of **sIMPD and other CMC documentation when required**.
* Coordinate regulatory **change\-control activities**, including planning, stakeholder coordination, action follow\-up and maintenance of trackers and systems.
* Provide regulatory intelligence and practical interpretation of EU/EEA requirements in response to client and cross\-functional questions.
* Work closely with Regulatory Affairs, CMC, Labelling, Quality Assurance and Clinical Supplies teams to identify regulatory implications, dependencies and required actions.
* Proactively identify issues, propose pragmatic solutions and ensure activities progress within agreed timelines.
* Support the development and continuous improvement of **processes, templates, trackers, decision frameworks and ways of working**.
* Ensure activities and deliverables meet applicable regulatory, quality and organizational requirements.

**Education and Experience Requirements**
-----------------------------------------

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent in a relevant scientific discipline; Chemistry, Biochemistry, Molecular Biology, Pharmaceutical Sciences or related disciplines preferred.
* **8\+ years of directly relevant Regulatory Affairs experience**, with a strong CMC background.
* Strong experience with EU/EEA clinical trial regulatory requirements and CMC regulatory documentation.
* Practical experience performing **regulatory change assessments**, including assessing the impact of CMC, manufacturing, supply or labelling changes.
* Experience determining whether changes require substantial or non\-substantial modification under applicable EU clinical trial requirements.
* Experience supporting **EU Clinical Trials Regulation submissions**.
* Strong CMC authoring and review expertise, including experience with **simplified IMPDs or comparable CMC documentation**.
* Experience with pharmaceutical manufacturing, commercial medicinal products, clinical supplies and/or quality documentation preferred.
* Experience working directly with clients and coordinating activities across multiple functions and stakeholders preferred.


Equivalent combinations of education, training and directly related experience may also be considered.

**Knowledge, Skills and Abilities**
-----------------------------------

* Strong knowledge of **EU/EEA clinical trial and CMC regulatory requirements**.
* Ability to interpret regulatory requirements and translate them into clear, practical and defensible regulatory assessments.
* Strong analytical skills and ability to compare complex documentation and identify regulatory impact.
* Excellent **organizational, planning and change\-management skills**, with the ability to manage multiple activities and dependencies concurrently.
* Strong **process\-oriented mindset**, with the ability to bring structure to evolving activities and define effective ways of working.
* Excellent client and stakeholder management skills, including **patience, resilience and professionalism**.
* Proactive approach with the ability to work independently, exercise sound judgement and drive activities to completion.
* Excellent written and spoken English and strong attention to detail.
* Strong Microsoft Word and Excel skills, including document review, formatting and version comparison.
* Ability to work effectively across Regulatory Affairs, CMC, Quality, Labelling, Clinical Supplies and other functions.
* Comfortable working in a **changing and evolving environment**.

**Working Conditions**
----------------------

* Remote/home\-based working may be available from an eligible European location.
* Regular client interaction, including participation in **weekly client meetings**, is preferred.
* Ability to attend **approximately monthly onsite meetings in the Basel, Switzerland area** is expected.
* Occasional additional travel may be required.

title: Senior Supplier Quality Expert CATS
description:
**Senior Supplier Quality Expert CATS**
=======================================

**Location:** Palazzo Pignano (CR)  

**Work Model:** Onsite

  

At Fresenius Medical Care, we are the global leader in kidney care, committed to improving the lives of patients with chronic kidney disease. Our mission is to deliver high\-quality, innovative products, services, and care across the entire healthcare journey. Guided by our vision—“Creating a future worth living. For patients. Worldwide. Every day.”—we work with purpose and compassion, supported by a global team of over 125,000 employees.

  

Within our Care Enablement segment, we develop and provide life\-sustaining medical products, digital health solutions, and therapies that empower clinical teams and improve patient outcomes. Our FME Reignite strategy drives transformation through innovation, efficiency, and sustainable growth.


Our values guide how we work:

* We Care for our patients, each other, and our communities
* We Connect across teams and borders to deliver excellence together
* We Commit to doing things the right way— growing with purpose and leading kidney care with integrity and innovation

 **Information about plant**


Located in northern Italy, our Palazzo Pignano plant serves as a key center for the production and development of dialysis\-related medical devices. With more than 550 employees, the plant specializes in manufacturing both peritoneal dialysis (PD) disposables and hemodialysis (HD) bloodline components. It combines large\-scale production capabilities with strong R\&D and engineering expertise. By utilizing advanced technologies to ensure the highest standards in dialysis product manufacturing, we’re not only driving innovation — we’re also creating meaningful change for patients worldwide.


Join our passionate team and be part of this global impact!

**The Opportunity**
-------------------


As a **Senior Supplier Quality Expert CATS**, you will play a key role in driving Supplier Quality Management activities in Palazzo Pignano manufacturing site. You will be responsible for ensuring supplier compliance, product quality, and continuous improvement throughout the supply chain, while supporting strategic supplier development and regulatory compliance initiatives.


Working closely with Procurement, Operations, R\&D, Regulatory Affairs, Supplier Engineering, and external suppliers, you will contribute to maintaining the highest quality standards for our medical device manufacturing operations.  



  

**Your Responsibilities**
=========================

**Supplier Quality Management**
-------------------------------

* Lead Supplier Quality Management activities within the Bloodlines division.
* Implement and maintain Supplier Quality Assurance systems in alignment with global FMC policies and procedures.
* Drive supplier qualification, selection, auditing, and continuous development programs.
* Ensure supplier compliance with quality requirements and regulatory standards.
* Support supplier process validation, risk management, and change management activities.
* Assess and approve supplier\-related changes through Change Control processes.

**Supplier Audits \& Compliance**
---------------------------------

* Plan and conduct on\-site and remote supplier audits in accordance with ISO 13485 and applicable regulatory requirements.
* Monitor supplier performance and quality metrics.
* Ensure material and product quality across the entire supply chain.
* Support site and supplier transfer activities.
* Collaborate with Regulatory Affairs and Quality teams to ensure ongoing compliance.

**Quality Systems \& Continuous Improvement**
---------------------------------------------

* Investigate and manage supplier\-related deviations, complaints, and CAPA activities.
* Analyze supplier performance data and develop improvement plans.
* Prepare and present supplier performance reviews and management reports.
* Identify quality risks and implement corrective and preventive actions.
* Promote continuous improvement initiatives and best practices across the supplier network.

**Stakeholder Collaboration**
-----------------------------

* Act as a key quality partner for Procurement, Operations, R\&D, Regulatory Affairs, Supplier Engineering, and manufacturing sites.
* Support SOP deployment and training activities across the assigned plants.
* Provide expert guidance on supplier quality topics and quality management processes.
* Collaborate with suppliers, notified bodies, and regulatory agencies when required.

**Your Profile**
================

* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Biomedical Engineering, Quality Management, or a related technical field.
* Several years of experience in Quality Management, preferably in Supplier Quality or Supplier Management.
* Experience in supplier qualification, audits, supplier development, and quality system implementation.
* Strong knowledge of supplier quality tools and methodologies.
* Experience working in a regulated environment, preferably within MedTech, pharmaceutical, or healthcare industries.
* Fluent English; German language skills are considered a strong advantage.

**Technical \& Professional Skills**
------------------------------------

* Strong knowledge of GMP requirements and quality management systems.
* Good understanding of ISO 9001, ISO 13485, MDSAP, and applicable regulatory requirements.
* Practical experience with CAPA, 8D, Root Cause Analysis, FMEA, and Change Control processes.
* Experience with process validation in medical device manufacturing.
* Knowledge of manufacturing commodities such as plastics, chemicals, electronics, or injection molding.
* Advanced skills in Excel, SAP, KPI analysis, reporting, and dashboard creation.
* Experience with TrackWise or equivalent Quality Management Systems is preferred.
* Knowledge of Lean, Six Sigma, or Continuous Improvement methodologies is an advantage.
* Project Management experience is highly desirable.

**Personal Competencies**
-------------------------

* Strong analytical mindset and structured problem\-solving approach.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
* Ability to influence, moderate discussions, and drive decisions.
* High level of accountability and organizational capability.
* Team\-oriented attitude with strong intercultural awareness.

Ability to work effectively in a global and matrix organization.  
* 

  

**Our Offer for You**
---------------------


There is a lot you can discover at Fresenius Medical Care, regardless in which field you are an expert and how much experience you have \- all dedicated to your professional journey.

  

* Whether in front of or behind the scenes \- you are helping to make ever better medicine available to more and more people around the world
* Individual opportunities for self\-determined career planning and professional development
* A corporate culture in which there is enough room for innovative thinking \- to find the best solution together, not the quickest one
* A large number of committed people with a wide range of skills, talents and experience
* The indicative annual base salary range for this position is between €40\.000 and €46\.000

title: Product Injection Expert
description:
**About the Company**

  

ZEISS is technology and innovation. Founded in Germany, in 1846, ZEISS is an internationally leading technology enterprise operating in the optics and optoelectronics industries across 50 countries. As a company wholly owned by a foundation, ZEISS is committed to responsibility in all its activities. As a pioneer in scientific optics, its employees across the globe continue to push the boundaries of what is possible. With a strong focus on quality and innovation, ZEISS creates value for its customers and helps shape new ways of seeing the world.  



  

**About the Role**

  

We’re looking for an Injection Product Expert to join us in Castiglione Olona, Varese, Italy. Within our Product Development organisation, you will work across Engineering, Production, Quality, Regulatory Affairs, Logistics and Product teams to support the successful development and industrialisation of injection\-molded Sun Lens products. As Injection Product Expert, you will manage the development of injection\-molded Sun Lens products, taking responsibility for projects from initial technical feasibility through to production readiness and successful market introduction.  



  

**Responsibilities**

  

* The role of Injection Product Expert will involve:
* Managing the end\-to\-end New Product Development process for thermoplastic injection molding projects, including new molds, materials, lens thicknesses, inserts and product changes.
* Driving development cycles for thermoplastic materials, including Polycarbonate and Polyamide, and assessing their suitability for new product applications.
* Conducting technical feasibility assessments and defining testing, qualification, validation and industrialization plans in collaboration with Engineering, Quality and Regulatory Affairs.
* Leading cross\-functional coordination between Product Development, Production, Logistics and Engineering to ensure development schedules and product release deadlines are achieved.
* Driving production readiness for new injected product launches and ensuring Time\-to\-Market targets are met, working with Key Account Managers and customers when required.
* Leading product testing activities in partnership with the Product Team and working with Quality to establish appropriate product specifications.
* Investigating non\-conformities and development failures alongside Engineering, applying Six Sigma methodologies, Design of Experiments and Minitab analysis where appropriate.
* Tracking and documenting development progress through internal company systems and portals, including Friday and the NPR portal.

**Qualifications**

  

* Your Experience
* A university degree in a scientific or technical discipline, ideally Materials Science, Mechanical Engineering or a related field.
At least 2–3 years’ professional experience within an injection molding environment.  
* 

  

**Required Skills**

  

* Good knowledge of thermoplastic materials and injection molding processes.
* Good knowledge of project management, with the ability to coordinate multiple development activities and stakeholders.
* Strong organisational skills, with experience of industrial resource planning, prioritization and task management.
* Strong relationship\-building, negotiation and communication skills, with the ability to work effectively across multidisciplinary teams.
* Good proficiency in both Italian and English.
Good working knowledge of Microsoft Office.  
* 

  

**Preferred Skills**

  

* It would be desirable if you had:
* Approximately five years’ experience within injection molding or a related manufacturing environment.
* Experience using Minitab and applying Six Sigma methodologies, including Design of Experiments.
Experience supporting the industrialization and launch of thermoplastic injection\-molded products.  
* 

  

**Pay range and compensation package**

  

If you join ZEISS, you will have access to a range of benefits, including:  



  

* Salary: 30,000€ \- 45,000€ base salary
* Bonus: Attendance, Production and Performance related
* General Welfare Benefits
* Subsidized canteed
Smart Working (3 days in the office, 2 days smart working)  
* 

  

Role Details  



  

The role is based in Castiglione Olona and will require flexibility to travel, including both short\- and long\-range business travel. Apply now to take the next step in joining ZEISS, where you can push technological boundaries, shape markets and contribute to the advancement of society.  



  

*ZEISS is committed to responsibility in all its activities and to creating an inclusive work environment. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to any protected characteristic, and ZEISS encourages applications from candidates of all backgrounds who want to contribute to pushing the boundaries of what is possible.*

description:
**Description**


We are seeking an experienced and scientifically credible Regional MSL Manager to lead and support a team of Medical Science Liaisons across Europe within Neuroscience and Psychiatry.  

This role will focus on leveraging field medical expertise to accelerate clinical trial delivery through investigator engagement, site support, patient identification, enrolment, and retention initiatives for priority neuroscience programmes. The Regional MSL Manager will combine people leadership responsibilities with a strong operational focus, ensuring the field medical team effectively supports clinical development objectives whilst maintaining high\-quality scientific exchange with healthcare professionals and external stakeholders.


Working closely with Medical Affairs, Clinical Development, Clinical Operations, and external study partners, the successful candidate will lead strategies that enhance study site performance, support patient recruitment goals, and generate valuable scientific insights from the field. The individual will remain closely connected to field activities, providing coaching and support to MSLs while driving excellence in trial support, stakeholder engagement, compliance, and execution.  

This position offers an opportunity to lead a high\-performing field medical team while contributing directly to the successful execution of clinical programmes and improved outcomes for patients living with neurological and psychiatric disorders.

* Lead, coach, and develop a team of Medical Science Liaisons across multiple European markets.

* Partner closely with Clinical Development, Clinical Operations, and study teams to identify and address barriers to site activation and patient recruitment.
* Ensure MSLs maintain effective territory engagement plans with investigators, research centres, and referral networks to support study objectives.
* Support study feasibility assessments and site identification activities by leveraging scientific expertise and field insights.

* Gather, analyse, and communicate actionable field insights relating to study execution, recruitment challenges, treatment pathways, and investigator needs.
* Work collaboratively with Medical Affairs, Clinical Development, Regulatory, Market Access, and Commercial teams to ensure aligned execution of programme objectives.
* Support clinical study steering committees, investigator meetings, advisory interactions, and other study\-related activities as appropriate.

* Strong communication, coaching, leadership, and stakeholder management skills.

* Solid understanding of compliance, pharmacovigilance, and ethical requirements governing medical activities and clinical research interactions.
* Ability to operate effectively across multiple countries and cultures within a matrix organisation.
* Fluency in English; additional European languages are advantageous.


Willingness to travel extensively across Europe. Office**Job Description**


Join Us as a Regulatory Affairs Manager

  

As a Regulatory Affairs Manager, you'll offer innovative solutions, including regulatory affairs expertise and client interface, to provide strategic regulatory intelligence and guidance supporting product development from preclinical stages through registration and product optimization.


Beyond regulatory expertise, this position requires a strong **operational mindset, decision\-making ownership, and cross\-functional leadership capability**. The Regulatory Affairs Lead (RAL) will **own regulatory decision\-making for the assigned clinical program and drive the cross\-functional clinical trial team toward execution of the regulatory strategy and achievement of program objectives**.

  

Working closely with Clinical Operations and other key functions, the RAL will **drive alignment, accountability, and execution across the clinical trial team**, ensuring regulatory requirements and dependencies are understood and incorporated into operational plans. The RAL is expected not only to provide regulatory advice, but also to actively lead the team through regulatory challenges and decisions to maintain progress against agreed study milestones and strategic objectives.

  

What You’ll Do:

### **Regulatory Strategy \& Decision Ownership**

* **Own regulatory decision\-making** for assigned clinical trials and programs, ensuring decisions are consistent with the agreed indication\-level regulatory strategy.
* **Translate the agreed indication\-level strategy into an actionable trial\-level regulatory strategy and execution plan**, defining regulatory pathways, priorities, deliverables, dependencies, risks, and timelines.
* Provide strategic regulatory intelligence, guidance, and technical expertise to internal and external stakeholders on projects of moderate to high complexity.
* Maintain current knowledge of applicable legislation, regulatory requirements, guidelines, and emerging regulatory developments and translate these into relevant strategic and operational guidance.
* Serve as a regulatory subject\-matter expert across global, regional, and country\-specific requirements.

### **Cross\-Functional Leadership \& Execution**

* **Drive the cross\-functional clinical trial team to execute the agreed regulatory strategy and achieve study and program objectives**, providing clear regulatory direction and ensuring timely resolution of regulatory and operational challenges.
* Partner closely with Clinical Operations and other functions to integrate regulatory requirements, dependencies, risks, and timelines into study operational plans.
* Establish clear regulatory priorities and accountabilities across the clinical trial team and proactively identify issues that could affect regulatory deliverables or study milestones.
* Lead cross\-functional discussions through regulatory challenges, ensuring decisions are made at the appropriate level, documented, communicated, and translated into action.
* Escalate significant regulatory risks and strategic issues when appropriate while maintaining ownership of follow\-through and resolution.
* Participate in launch meetings, project reviews, governance discussions, and project team meetings.

### **Regulatory Submissions \& Compliance**

* Lead the development and execution of global regulatory strategies and preparation of submissions to **Regulatory Authorities and Ethics Committees**, ensuring high\-quality standards and compliance with applicable local, regional, and global requirements.
* Provide senior review and strategic advice for regional regulatory submissions, ensuring deliverables meet or exceed applicable quality and regulatory requirements.
* Ensure regulatory deliverables are accurate, consistent, compliant, and completed within agreed timelines.
* Ensure compliance with applicable organizational and regulatory SOPs, WPDs, policies, and procedures.

* Ensure quality performance across assigned and managed projects.
* Manage project budgets and forecasting activities.
* Identify out\-of\-scope activities in a timely manner and collaborate with relevant departments to support contract modifications and associated follow\-through.

* Collaborate with Business Development on pricing and new\-business opportunities, including client presentations and development of proposal text, scope, and budgets.
* Provide matrix/project leadership, coaching, training, and guidance to junior team members.

**Education \& Experience**
---------------------------

* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent relevant formal academic/vocational qualification.

* Excellent written and verbal English communication skills, as well as local\-language capability where applicable.
* Demonstrated ability to **make and own regulatory decisions**, balancing regulatory requirements, strategic objectives, operational feasibility, risk, and timelines.

Your responsibilities will include:  


Conducting regular 1:1 meetings with direct reports, providing coaching, performance feedback, career development support, and oversight of project responsibilities.

A collaborative and inclusive leadership style with a genuine interest in supporting the development and success of others.  
Strong organizational and computer skills, including MS Office applications.  


Above all, we are interested in individuals who demonstrate leadership potential, strong stakeholder engagement, sound operational judgment, and a proven track record of successful clinical project delivery.  


Ready for your next step?  


If you are already an experienced people manager, or an accomplished Clinical Project Manager who has naturally taken on leadership, mentoring, or coaching responsibilities and is now ready to move into formal line management, we would love to hear from you.

Quality Assurance (QA) Manager – Food Supplements

**Location:** Hybrid  
**Working pattern:** Full\-time  
**Reporting to:** Founder \& CEO  
**Scope:** UK, EU and international markets

About the Role

Minerva is looking for an experienced **Quality Assurance Manager** to take ownership of product quality and food\-safety assurance across our growing portfolio of food supplements.

Our products are developed by our R\&D/NPD team and manufactured by third\-party contract manufacturers. You will independently verify that finished products, manufacturing processes, packaging and supporting documentation meet Minerva’s quality standards, applicable food\-supplement legislation and our IFS Broker\-aligned quality management system.

This is a hands\-on role with significant ownership and autonomy. You will work closely with our contract manufacturers, packaging suppliers, Regulatory Compliance, R\&D/NPD and Customer Care teams across the UK, EU and international markets.

As our portfolio expands into new products, countries and languages, you will help ensure our quality systems remain robust, consistent and audit\-ready.

**Please note:** New product concepts, formulation development and ingredient sourcing sit with our R\&D/NPD team and are outside the scope of this role.

What You’ll Be Responsible For

* Own and maintain finished\-product specifications, raw\-material checklists and product quality checklists across all SKUs and market variants.
* Manage document control and versioning to ensure specifications and quality records remain accurate and current.
* Manage the ongoing quality monitoring programme for contract manufacturers and packaging suppliers, including certification status, audit reports, GMP, FSSC 22000, BRCGS, HACCP and other relevant quality credentials.
* Review **Certificates of Analysis (CoAs)**, batch documentation and manufacturing records prior to product release.
* Place batches on quality hold where required and coordinate investigation and resolution of deviations and non\-conformities.
* Manage packaging and label quality checks for each SKU, market and language version before artwork approval.
* Verify supplier Declarations of Conformity and relevant food\-contact\-material and GMP compliance documentation.
* Maintain SKU\-level packaging data, including material composition, weight and recyclability information, and provide accurate data to Regulatory Compliance for EPR and PPWR requirements.
* Act as **HACCP Team Lead**, maintaining and reviewing the company HACCP plan.
* Conduct six\-monthly reviews to confirm quality procedures are being implemented effectively.
* Own the quality aspects of customer complaint monitoring, investigation and trend analysis.
* Maintain and manage product recall and withdrawal procedures.
* Represent Quality within the company’s Crisis Management Team.
* Deliver product\-safety and quality training and maintain appropriate training and competency records.
* Support Minerva’s preparation for **IFS Broker certification**, certification audits and ongoing surveillance.

What Success Looks Like

You will help us maintain a proactive, well\-controlled and audit\-ready quality system, with a particular focus on:

* 100% CoA and required batch\-documentation review before product release.
* Timely investigation and closure of manufacturing non\-conformities, with a target of resolution within 30 days.
* Current and valid quality certification held on file for all core contract manufacturers and packaging suppliers.
* Prompt investigation and response to product\-safety and quality\-related customer queries, working with Customer Care.
* Completion of scheduled six\-monthly quality\-procedure implementation reviews.
* Strong preventative controls designed to minimise product\-safety incidents, withdrawals and recalls.

About You

You will be comfortable working independently and making evidence\-based quality decisions in a business that outsources manufacturing.

You should have:

* At least **3 years’ experience in Quality Assurance, Quality Management or Food Safety** within food supplements, nutraceuticals, functional foods or another regulated food category.
* Experience working with **third\-party manufacturers / contract manufacturers** rather than solely within an in\-house production environment.
* Strong practical knowledge of **HACCP** and quality\-management systems.
* Working knowledge of UK and EU food\-supplement requirements, including relevant aspects of:
* Directive 2002/46/EC
* Regulation (EC) No 1924/2006
* Regulation (EU) No 1169/2011
* Knowledge of **Health Canada** requirements for supplements or natural health products.
* Familiarity with **IFS Broker** or another relevant GFSI\-recognised standard.
* Experience reviewing specifications, CoAs, batch records, supplier documentation and product\-release documentation.
* Confidence managing multiple SKUs, markets and language variants simultaneously.
* Excellent attention to detail and strong document\-control skills.
* The judgement and confidence to challenge suppliers, investigate deviations and place products on hold where necessary.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to work effectively with suppliers and colleagues remotely.

Desirable Experience

It would be an advantage if you also have:

* FDA / US regulatory or quality experience.
* IFS Broker experience.
* HACCP Team Leader or Lead Auditor training.
* Experience preparing for third\-party certification audits.
* Experience with packaging compliance, food\-contact materials, EPR or PPWR.
* Experience working in a fast\-growing food\-supplement or nutraceutical business.

Working Arrangements

The role is suitable for candidates with a solid engineering background who are motivated to develop experience in licensing, regulatory compliance and safety documentation.

Your work will support the Licensing team and the wider Decommissioning \& Waste Management Programme, helping ensure that technical documentation is complete, traceable and aligned with project, client and regulatory requirements.

* **Licensing documentation:** Support the preparation of licensing files, periodic reports, technical notes and supporting annexes for facilities within the programme.

* **Regulatory and safety support:** Assist senior colleagues in preparing clearance dossiers, responses to competent authorities and inputs for safety analyses.
* **Environmental licensing:** Contribute to environmental permitting and EIA\-related activities for decommissioning and interim waste storage projects.
* **Document control and project follow\-up:** Maintain licensing records, support document reviews, track review and approval timelines, and prepare summaries, meeting notes and internal technical briefs.

**The team around you**


You will be part of the Licensing team within the Decommissioning \& Waste Management Programme, working on technical documentation and regulatory support for nuclear, decommissioning and waste management facilities.


The culture: structured, collaborative and focused on learning from experienced technical professionals.  

The projects: licensing, safety documentation, environmental permitting and technical coordination for facilities in operation and decommissioning.  

The opportunity: a strong entry point into licensing and regulatory compliance within a complex, highly regulated technical environment.

* Basic knowledge, ideally acquired through university education, of licensing and regulatory frameworks applicable to nuclear, decommissioning or waste management facilities.
* Understanding of safety principles, environmental permitting processes and technical documentation workflows for complex industrial facilities.
* Italian and English at B2 level or above are required.
* Methodical working style, strong attention to detail, good analytical skills, clear written communication and willingness to learn within a multidisciplinary team.


We do not expect you to know everything. We are looking for curiosity, motivation and willingness to learn. From day one, you will contribute to real projects, receive guidance from experienced professionals and progressively build your technical confidence in licensing, regulatory compliance and safety documentation.

**Life at WSP**


When our people thrive, our projects thrive. At WSP, you will be supported to build your career, take on meaningful challenges and learn from talented professionals across a global network. We encourage new ideas, growth and development in ways that reflect different career paths and ambitions.

**Compensation and benefits**


WSP is committed to pay transparency. The annual gross salary range for this position is €27,000 \- €30,000\. The final offer will be determined based on the successful candidate’s experience, qualifications and relevant expertise.

* Meal vouchers and wellbeing benefits.
* Supplementary healthcare coverage.
* Professional registration support, where applicable.
* Employee wellbeing and assistance programmes.
* Public transport and mobility support.
* Access to additional welfare initiatives, corporate discounts and employee perks.
* Opportunities for continuous learning and professional development.

description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------


There’s a universe of opportunity at Amazon.
  

  

At Amazon, your career doesn’t follow a straight line. It accelerates, twists, and challenges you in ways you never expected. From the moment you join, you’re part of something big: building products or services that reach millions and shaping how people live, work, and connect every day. This is where your ideas turn into real impact.
  

You’ll work with world class tools, global platforms, and systems built to operate at an extraordinary scale. You’ll move fast, experiment and launch solutions that matter. With endless opportunities to explore across teams and roles, you’ll learn quickly, apply what you know and discover skills you didn’t know existed. This is an environment designed for builders who want to see the impact of their work in the world. Ready to start your adventure?
  

  

What’s in it for you?
  

An internship at Amazon means real responsibility from day one. You’ll build, test, and learn alongside people who want to see you succeed, while making an impact that reaches far beyond campus.
  

  

Key job responsibilities  

* Observing the implementation and management of Amazon's safety programs and standards with the entire internal and external project team.

  

* Supporting the construction team to ensure that the skills and competencies of contract labor are appropriate to need and fit to undertake the work.

  

* Witnessing comprehensive budget, schedule tracking and forecasting which strives for frugality and accomplishing more with less while identifying and solving factors that may impede a successful project hand\-over to Amazon stakeholders.

  

* Studying the coordination with the authorities that have jurisdiction on the project to ensure regulatory compliance and smooth job execution.

  

* Partnering with internal customers and external stakeholders to earn trust and engage as a team to deliver results.

  

* Insisting on the highest standards by supporting the team to ensure contracted resources deliver work meeting duration and quality targets.

  

* Supporting construction managers to ensure all internal and external team members maintain schedules and budgets.

  

* Supporting more than one project in various locations, with potential travel to project sites.

  

A day in the life  

Location: Milan  

Start Date: January \- March 2027\. We don't offer 2026 start dates.  

Duration: 6 months minimum
  

This is not a remote internship opportunity  

  

Each day you will be observing Amazon Construction Managers act as owners to ensure the safe, on\-time, and in\-budget execution of Amazon construction projects. You may be asked to participate in daily tasks in support of the team, which may include coordinating with contractors on projected changes and project status, ensuring contractors are meeting their contractual obligations, seeking sustainable and environmentally friendly solutions throughout the construction process while implementing Amazon's green building practices, and utilizing Amazon information systems to record and update scheduling, budget, and other key developments. You may also observe and assist in negotiating terms of contracts with contractors, all while driving them to meet or exceed agreed\-to schedules and budgets. Additionally, you will observe and may participate in weekly architect, owner, and contractor meetings, providing input on root causes and corrective action.
  

  

This internship provides familiarization across construction, engineering, planning, project management, facilities management, and contract management — giving you a well\-rounded view of how Amazon delivers innovative physical assets from design review through final hand\-off.
  

  

About the team  

Intern Community:
  

As an Amazon Intern, you'll be part of a dynamic, supportive community that empowers your growth and development. You'll collaborate with interns from around the world, networking and participating in social events to broaden your perspectives. You can also join specialized groups focused on areas like sustainability to explore your diverse interests.
  

  

Support:
  

The internship program provides a robust support system, including weekly intern office hours, dedicated IT and HR support, and a program team committed to your success. This ensures you have the guidance and assistance needed to thrive.
  

  

Learning Sessions:
  

Exclusive learning sessions will further enhance your skills, granting you access to Amazon's industry\-leading learning platforms and the expertise of industry leaders. These structured development opportunities will prepare you for the next step in your career.
  

  

Opportunities:
  

Upon successful completion of the internship, you may be considered for a graduate role or a second internship, allowing you to continue your journey with Amazon. Additionally, you'll enjoy a competitive monthly salary, relocation support, and access to a range of employee benefits.
**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* Speak, write, and read fluently in English at C1 level or above
* Can sign a learning agreement with the University in which you are enrolled
* Currently in your penultimate or final year and working towards a university bachelor’s or master’s in Engineering, Construction Management or comparable field
* Available for a full\-time internship (40 hours/week) and commit to 6 month internship

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* Strong academic, leadership, and/or extracurricular record
* Effective interpersonal, written, and oral communication skills
* Ability to influence all levels of an organization
* Strong time management skills

We value your passion to discover, invent, simplify and build. Protecting your privacy and the security of your data is a longstanding top priority for Amazon. Please consult our Privacy Notice (https://www.amazon.jobs/en/privacy\_page) to know more about how we collect, use and transfer the personal data of our candidates.  

  

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. As a Microsoft Data Center Project Manager (DCPM), you will be accountable for **planning, coordinating, and delivering projects inside live datacenter environments**, ensuring work is executed safely, on time, within scope, and in alignment with Microsoft standards and operational requirements.


The role bridges **datacenter operations, engineering, construction, IT/network, and external vendors**, translating business and technical objectives into executable project plans.


Microsoft’s Cloud Operations \& Innovation (CO\+I) is the engine that powers our cloud services. As a CO\+I DCPM, you will perform a key role in delivering the core infrastructure and foundational technologies for Microsoft's online services including Bing, Office 365, Xbox, OneDrive, and the Microsoft Azure platform. As a group, CO\+I is focused on the personal and professional development for all employees and offers trainings and growth opportunities including Career Rotation Programs, Diversity \& Inclusion trainings and events, and professional certifications.


Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond.

 **Responsibilities**  

* Owns end\-to\-end project execution for datacenter initiatives from intake through close\-out, holding self\-accountable for service quality, completeness, and the resulting customer experience across IT, network, infrastructure, remediation, and modernization projects.
* Builds and manages project plans, schedules, milestones, and dependencies across multiple parallel workstreams, proactively reviewing schedules to avoid conflicts and offering alternatives when defining customer solutions.
* Executes projects inside live production datacenters in strict adherence to safety, security, and change\-management standards, including MOP/SOP compliance and access controls; follows and reports any safety or security issues or concerns immediately.
* Recognizes and communicates the potential customer impact of operational events such as lock\-downs and maintenance windows, planning accordingly to minimize disruption to clients and the business.
* Acts as the single coordination point between Datacenter Operations, Engineering, Construction, IT/Network teams, vendors, integrators, and contractors, managing relationships to ensure all expectations are clarified, documented, and met.
* Proactively identifies schedule, technical, safety, and operational risks, suggests ways to reduce maintenance risk, and develops mitigation and contingency plans in collaboration with relevant teams.
* Performs troubleshooting for service incidents and escalates appropriately to meet SLAs and OLAs with minimal disruption to clients and the business.
* Demonstrates conscientiousness around cost, tracks project costs and resource utilization, and contributes to keeping work within approved budgets and timelines.

  

**Qualifications** **Required Qualifications:**

* High School Qualification or equivalent, AND experience supporting IT equipment or related technology or delivering server and network deployment projects in large\-scale environments OR equivalent experience.

**Additional or preferred qualifications**

* Bachelor's or Technical College Degree in Computer Science, Math, Telecommunications, Electrical/Mechanical Engineering, Supply Chain Management or related field AND experience in working in physical IT infrastructures (e.g., Servers, SANs, Networking, Capacity, DC Rack/Enclosures, structured cabling) OR High School Qualification or equivalent AND experience working in physical IT infrastructures (e.g., Servers, SANs, Networking, Capacity, DC Rack/Enclosures, structured cabling) OR equivalent experience.
* Applicable certifications: APICS/Inventory Control, CompTIA, Microsoft, Network Certifications, CDCP, CCNA Certifications, ITIL, Microsoft Operations Framework (MOF) Certifications.

 **Background Check Requirements:**


Ability to meet Microsoft, customer and/or government security screening requirements are required for this role. These requirements include, but are not limited to the following specialized security screenings:

* Microsoft Cloud Background Check: This position will be required to pass the Microsoft Cloud background check upon hire/transfer and every two years thereafter.

**Department:** Group Tax**Contract:** Permanent  

  

The Regional Tax Analyst supports Group wide tax reporting, compliance, and risk management across multiple jurisdictions. The role plays a critical part in the preparation, review, and consolidation of current and deferred tax positions and tax disclosures, ensuring accuracy, consistency, and compliance with Group accounting policies and local tax regulations. Working closely with Group Finance, local markets, auditors, and external advisers, the role contributes directly to the integrity of Group financial reporting, Effective Tax Rate (ETR) forecasting, and tax governance  

  

**IN THIS EXCITING ROLE YOU WILL:**  

Group Tax Reporting \& Financial Close  

  

* Coordinate interim and year end Group tax reporting in collaboration with Finance teams, auditors, and external advisers.
* Build strong working relationships with finance and business stakeholders to ensure smooth execution of Group tax reporting cycles.
* Act as a key representative of Group Tax for reporting matters and lead business partnering with the Group Financial Reporting team.
* Support ETR forecasting, budgeting, and variance analysis versus prior periods and plan.
* Review and support the preparation of statutory tax disclosures and notes to the financial statements.

  

Governance, Controls \& Documentation  

  

* Support the design and operation of tax accounting controls under internal control frameworks.
* Assist with documentation for internal and external audits, including:

o Tax provision workpapers.
o Deferred tax support schedules.
o Uncertain tax position (UTP) analyses.  

  

* Contribute to Tax Control Framework (TCF) documentation and testing.
* Support regional implementation of new tax accounting or reporting requirements (e.g. Pillar Two).
* Lead technical tax accounting for Group Reporting; maintain IAS 12 knowledge.

  

Tax Risk, Audits \& Provisions  

  

* Track regional tax audits, disputes, and exposures.
* Assist with assessment and documentation of tax risks and provisions.
* Support preparation of UTP analyses and coordination with Group Tax.
* Ensure audit outcomes are reflected appropriately in tax reporting and provisions.

Regional Coordination \& Governance
* Act as the regional point of contact between local markets and Group Tax.
* Ensure consistent application of group tax policies, tax control framework, and internal guidelines.
* Oversight of the Group’s tax compliance programme including a review of all jurisdictional filings.

  

Data, Systems \& Process Improvement  

  

* Support improvements in tax reporting processes, including standardisation and automation and data quality enhancements.
* Work with Finance and IT on ERP and reporting tools (e.g. SAP) and adoption of tax technology tools.
* Prepare tax reporting packs, dashboards, and management presentations.

Ad\-hoc
* Support Head of Tax with tax projects as they arise. Support other members of the Group tax team with ad hoc queries, projects and transactions as required.

  

**YOU CAN BE SUCCESFULL IN THIS ROLE IF YOU HAVE:**  

**Essential Criteria*** Qualified accountant (ACA/ACCA) or equivalent tax qualification (CTA or equivalent).
* 7\+ years of relevant tax experience; experience in a big 4 audit/tax advisory firm and/or a tax function of a multinational group.
* Fluent in English (both written and oral).
* Strong interpersonal and communication skills, effective partnering with non tax professionals across a cross functional organisation to proactively anticipate business needs and provide practical tax support to the business.

  

**Desired Criteria*** Strong knowledge of tax accounting and reporting standards (IAS 12\).
* Solid understanding of corporate income tax and deferred taxation mechanics.
* Experience with tax provision tools or Excel\-based provision models.
* Comfortable analysing ETR drivers and explaining variances to senior stakeholders.
* Previous experience of working within an ERP / SAP.

description:
**Sirio**, a premier global aircraft management company, is seeking **Licensed Aircraft Maintenance Technicians** to join our AMO team **in Milan.**


With over 40 years of experience and as a vital member of the Directional Aviation Portfolio, we have created a reputation for excellence. Our success is attributed to the dedication of our talented professionals, and this role is critical in maintaining the infrastructure that allows them to thrive.


**About the Role**


As a Licensed Aircraft Maintenance Technician, you will play an essential role in ensuring the continued airworthiness, safety, and reliability of our aircraft fleet.


You will perform inspections, troubleshooting activities, repairs, modifications, and maintenance tasks on aircraft structures, engines, and systems while ensuring full compliance with regulatory and company requirements.


Working closely with fellow technicians, engineers, and operational teams, you will contribute to a safety\-first environment focused on quality, accuracy, and continuous improvement.


**What Success Looks Like in This Role**


Success in this role means performing maintenance activities safely and efficiently, maintaining accurate technical documentation, identifying and resolving technical issues effectively, and contributing to the continued airworthiness and reliability of the fleet while meeting regulatory and operational standards.


**Key Responsibilities**


* Perform scheduled and unscheduled maintenance activities on aircraft structures, engines, and systems in accordance with approved maintenance data and regulatory requirements.
* Carry out inspections, troubleshooting, repairs, modifications, and functional testing of aircraft and aircraft systems.
* Remove, disassemble, inspect, repair, assemble, and install aircraft components as required.
* Operate tools, equipment, and testing devices necessary to perform maintenance activities safely and effectively.
* Complete maintenance records and documentation accurately and in a timely manner.
* Ensure compliance with company procedures, EASA regulations, quality standards, and HSE requirements.
* Interpret technical manuals, maintenance instructions, engineering orders, and aircraft drawings.
* Maintain an organized, safe, and professional work environment.
* Collaborate effectively with colleagues, supervisors, and operational stakeholders to support maintenance objectives.
* Support additional maintenance tasks and projects as assigned.


**Required \& Preferred Qualifications**


We recognize that strong candidates may not meet every preferred qualification listed below. If you believe your experience and capabilities align with this opportunity, we encourage you to apply.


**Required Qualifications**


* Valid EASA Part\-66 B1 or B1/B2 Aircraft Maintenance Licence.
* Working knowledge of EASA Part\-145 regulations and maintenance requirements.
* Previous hands\-on aircraft maintenance experience in a commercial, business aviation, or military aviation environment.
* Legal right to work in Italy.
* Professional working proficiency in English (minimum B2 level).
* Valid driver's licence.
* Ability to perform the physical requirements of the role.

### **Preferred Qualifications**


* Type ratings on business jet aircraft.
* Italian language proficiency.
* Ability to travel internationally when operational requirements require support activities outside Italy.
* Experience working within a business aviation maintenance organization.


**Knowledge, Skills \& Professional Attributes**


* Ability to diagnose, troubleshoot, and resolve technical issues using approved maintenance procedures.
* Strong understanding of aircraft maintenance practices, safety standards, and regulatory compliance requirements.
* Ability to interpret technical manuals, maintenance data, and engineering documentation.
* Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple priorities effectively.
* Attention to detail in both maintenance execution and technical record keeping.
* Ability to work effectively under operational deadlines while maintaining safety and quality standards.
* Strong communication skills and ability to collaborate within a multidisciplinary maintenance team.
* Commitment to continuous learning and professional development.


**Compensation \& Benefits**


### **Contract**


* Permanent employment contract under CCNL Trasporto Aereo
* Compensation package determined based on qualifications and experience (licenses, experience and type\-ratings)
* Salary range: **€55,000 \- €95,000 gross annual salary**.

### **Location**


* Milan Linate Airport (LIML)
* Piazzale Ovest, Milan, Italy

### **Benefits**


* Private health insurance
* Pension fund contribution matching
* Meal vouchers
* Complimentary on\-site parking.


**Work Environment**


While performing the duties of this job, the employee is frequently exposed to fumes or airborne particles, moving mechanical parts and vibration. The employee is occasionally exposed to a variety of extreme weather conditions. The noise level in the work environment and job sites can be loud.


**Physical Demands**


The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job.


While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to talk or hear. The employee is frequently required to:


* Stand; walk; use hands to handle or feel; and reach with hands and arms
* The employee is occasionally required to sit, climb, balance, stoop, kneel, crouch or crawl
* The employee must frequently lift and move up to 5Kg and occasionally lift and move up to 22\.5 KG
* Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision, distance vision, color vision, peripheral vision, depth perception and ability to adjust focus.


*We understand that not every candidate will meet every requirement listed above. If your experience is close and you believe you could succeed in this role, we encourage you to apply.*


*We are committed to building a diverse and inclusive team, and we welcome applications from individuals of all backgrounds.*


**Our Fundamental Principles**


* **Employees are the Foundation of a Service Company:** Recognizing that our people drive our success, we prioritize creating an environment where each team member can thrive and contribute meaningfully.
* **Fanatical Attention to Detail:** Safety is always \#1 at Sirio. Your commitment to precision is essential in ensuring that every task, project, and interaction is executed with utmost accuracy and excellence.
* **Maintain a Long\-Term Approach to Relationships:** Cultivating enduring relationships with colleagues, vendors, and clients is crucial to our success. Your kindness, courtesy, and commitment to sustained partnerships contribute to our collaborative environment.
